mode.description: ReleaseFed pools are volume-controlled by this service (WIP limit is a hard invariant); FlowFed pools admit on priority only (WIP limit is an alarm threshold, not enforced).
mode.title: PoolMode

wipLimit.description: The pool's WIP limit: a positive integer no greater than 2147483647 (it is stored in a Postgres INTEGER; a larger value is `400 invalid-wip-limit`). Enforced as a hard invariant on `ReleaseFed` pools, stored but only informative on `FlowFed` pools. May be set below the current WIP: nothing is evicted, releases pause until WIP drops below it.
